text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hm, maybe let's take one more? Rice,
Urara, squeeze in a little bit! ♪
Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#Selfie #AuditioningNow
#ReadyToRiddle #LetsDoThis

#CheerUsOn" Okay, all set! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, these photos will make for lovely
memories. ...By the by, when
is the
audition supposed to begin?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It has been a while since each team was
guided into separate rooms.
Could this
time spent waiting be a part of the
audition too?

"Bum-ba-ba-buuum! Beauty Channel! ♪
Just kidding! Bonjour,
everyone, this is
Beauty Anshinzawa!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Where's this voice... coming from?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I think I know! The sound's coming from
that computer over there!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
We've gathered a whole bunch of
beautiful gems again this year, and
I
couldn't be happier! First, let me explain
the rules of the audition! ♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
This year's trial comes in the form of
riddles! Each team will be tasked with
solving three riddles in order to find the
chapel key somewhere
within this hotel!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The first two riddles will be different
for each team and take place in
different
locations. Only teams that solve the first
two riddles...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Will earn the chance to tackle the final
riddle in this "Special Room"
that I'm in
right now.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Teams that solve all three riddles and
obtain the chapel key will get the chance
to tell me what my racewear means to
them with a
beautiful proposal!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to hearing your passionate
vows—ones worthy of an
engagement to
my racewear. ♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, don't forget that I'll also be
taking into account the beauty each of
you gemstones shows off while solving
riddles! In any case,
you have until sunset today.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Then without any further ado, let the
Beauty Dream Cup muse audition begin!
May this year's audition be as
brilliant as
the last! ☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the audition's really started! I've
got butterflies, but let's all do
our best!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Oh... but where's the riddle we have
to solve?

text_block_list.name: Polite Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me,
I have a delivery for this room.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see, so each team gets their own riddle
sent to their room. ...Well
then, let's see
what this letter says.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Solve the riddle below to obtain the item
you seek."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Up in a gallery heaven-high, 10 becomes
1, and 100 becomes 10. There, travel
towards the queen's summit. The theater's
symphony shall sway the zelkova, before
flowing towards the capital."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Up in a gallery heaven-high..." That's
the
first place we need to go
to, I'm guessing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is just an idle thought, but
perhaps it refers to this hotel's
observation
deck?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
An observation deck! I didn't even know
this hotel had one. Have you
stayed here
before, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I haven't, but I was shown the guide map
when we arrived earlier. It's standard
protocol between my security and me to
prepare for
emergencies.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now if I recall, the map stated, "With an
outer perimeter of 100 meters, our
250-meter tall observation deck provides
a 360-degree
panoramic view of the city!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Fine, you remembered all those
details?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she's had to memorize plenty of
speeches... A truly astute—excuse me, got
a little carried away. We were heading to
the
observation deck, correct?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! We're so high up! Hey hey, do
you think we can see Tracen
from here?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Judging by this view,
the school's probably
located somewhere
behind you. Still, we
should focus on the riddle for now, Urara.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Right, we need to focus! Um, by "10
becomes 1, and 100 becomes
10," do you
think we need to count something?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Counting? Oh, like people? Or buildings?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I wonder... This is an audition for racewear, so I bet the riddle's got something to do with racing. Let's see, the riddle went...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Up in a gallery heaven-high, 10 becomes
1, and 100 becomes 10. There, travel
towards the queen's summit. The theater's
symphony shall sway the zelkova, before
flowing towards the capital."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Putting aside the numbers for now... When
you think of races and
theaters, it's gotta
be the Hanshin Racecourse in Takarazuka,
right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That would be a logical conclusion. The
last time I was invited to watch a race
there, we went to see a performance
afterwards. In that case, by "zelkova," it
means...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The big zelkova trees at Tokyo
Racecourse! ♪ And if we assume that the
last part about "flowing towards the
capital" is about the Yodo
River that flows near Kyoto Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then "travel towards the queen's summit"
must refer to the Oka Sho, the Japanese
Oaks, and the Shuka Sho—in other words,
the Triple
Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! We have to go to Hanshin
Racecourse right now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... Do we even have time to go to all
three racecourses before
sunset?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, you two. This is just a riddle,
so I doubt we have to
physically go to
each racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Most likely,
the key to solving this riddle
lies in the hint, "10 becomes
1, and 100
becomes 10."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno,
that's it! ♪ I just figured it all out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To be exact,
we'll find our answer if we do
laps around the deck! 1.6
laps to the right,
then 2.4 laps to the left,
and finally 2 laps to the right!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The key hint came from Fine—the info on
the hotel's guide map! ♪
